## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] New behavior has tests (analyzer errors need an analyzer test, optimizer changes need paired input and output tests)
- [ ] If anything in `src/` changed, I ran `npm run build:playground` and committed `docs/playground/`
- [ ] README, `docs/language-spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` match the change
